If we can just sneak back home without incident, I'll be satisfied&hellip;|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Jarl|<ref name="Bacta Raid">{{TCWComicCite|6.35|Bacta Raid}}</ref>}}
The '''''Medica''''' was a [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]].

==History==
The ''Medica'' was a [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. It was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jarl (captain)|Jarl]].

It picked up [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had been stranded on an asteroid. The ship was later attacked by [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] deserters for its [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. The Zygerrians had captured a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] vessel, the [[Wayfarer (spice transport)|''Wayfarer'']].

The Zygerrians were beaten, treated for their injuries and taken into custody.
